Application Data.NAME: Visionary Optics LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Visionary Optics LLC specializes in the retail sale of optical goods, including prescription eyewear, contact lenses, and related accessories. We also provide comprehensive eye examination services in collaboration with licensed optometrists. Our operations include in-store fittings, lens crafting, and customer consultations to ensure optimal visual health and satisfaction. Additionally, we offer online sales through our website, providing a convenient shopping experience for our clients.
